title: Intrinsic scalar/site/inverse-image cube
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a unital map $\varphi$ of finite commutative rings, let $i:U\to X$ be any morphism of schemes, and let $L\in D(X_{et},\operatorname{ULift} A)$. Use the actual comparison/realization functors $S^R_T=\mathtt{reductionSite}\ R\ T$, scalar functors $T^{et},T^{int}$, and inverse-image functors $P^{et},P^{int}$ of [def-sp-reduction-exceptional-realization-objects]. Write $s_T:S^A_T T^{int}_T\simeq T^{et}_T S^B_T$ for reductionSiteScalarIso, $r_R:S^R_X P^{int}_R\simeq P^{et}_R S^R_U$ for reductionSitePullbackIso, and $d^{int},d^{et}:T_XP_B\simeq P_AT_U$ for the specified scalar/pullback isomorphisms. Then, with Lean composition order, $ (d^{int}_L)^{-1};P^{int}_B(s_{X,L});r_{B,T^{et}_XL}=T^{int}_U(r_{A,L});s_{U,P^{et}_AL};S^B_U((d^{et}_L)^{-1})$. No boundedness or open-immersion hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Use the etale/pro-etale scalar/pullback cube in the fixed ModuleCat presentation. Both paths are inverse mates of the sectionwise scalar restriction square.

Transport through the intrinsic module equivalences, using the section-normalized realization scalar map and openSquarePullbackModel. Their exact restriction squares commute on every section; mate pasting and exact derived descent preserve that equality.
Insert the exact-to-derived ordinary inverse-image comparisons. Associativity gives the displayed equation, including identity maps, empty schemes and zero rings.

lean.statement:
theorem reductionSite_scalar_pullback
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {U X : Scheme.{u}} (i : U ⟶ X)
    (L : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) X) :
    (directImageScalarPullbackIso φ i).inv.app ((reductionSite A X).obj L) ≫
        (proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback B i).map
          ((reductionSiteScalarIso φ X).hom.app L) ≫
        (reductionSitePullbackIso B i).hom.app
          ((Etale.scalarExtension (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) X).obj L) =
      (scalarExtensionFunctor φ U).map ((reductionSitePullbackIso A i).hom.app L) ≫
        (reductionSiteScalarIso φ U).hom.app
          ((Etale.ordinaryFinitePullback (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) i).obj L) ≫
        (reductionSite B U).map
          ((Etale.scalarPullbackIso (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) i).inv.app L)
